{{Top|Leg}}
'''Alloy overlays''' were a type of armor enhancement that could have a variety of effects on the armor. The enhancement required high quality armor and adequate tools.<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
